supersedes.detail: The wrapper incorrectly required the F-MR35 owner candidate commit itself to be an ancestor of canonical. Correct governance is the admitted F-CI37 final authority in canonical lineage plus exact current candidate blob identity. Temporal authority was green and no production/reference/scientific source changed.

The independent F-MQ30 runner passed its internal held-out, fail-closed, worker-count, publication-order, O0/O2 and hard-mass gates and exported its summary PASS markers, but the outer RB1 wrapper incorrectly required internal per-case markers that the runner intentionally does not publish to stdout. The same latent wrapper defect was pre-emptively corrected for F-MQ29. No independent scientific attack, production source, reference source or acceptance threshold was changed.

immutability_rule: During decisive qualification, src, reference, tests/frb01 and the decisive workflow must remain byte-identical to this candidate. Any production source or reference change invalidates RB1 scientific release qualification and requires a fresh candidate after governed owner qualification/canonical admission. Any decisive test-harness change also requires a fresh release candidate before rerun.
evidence_only_rule: This descriptor update and later qualification/closeout records may advance the release branch without changing the scientifically tested src/reference trees. Such evidence-only descendants remain explicitly distinguishable from the frozen release candidate above.
historical_evidence_rule: Historical admission gates remain bound to their exact admitted heads. F-RB01 separately establishes current canonical preservation and integrated behavior without replaying historical one-delta assumptions as moving-current requirements.
scope_creep_rule: Capabilities admitted after the frozen RB1 scope remain NEXT_RELEASE by default and do not enlarge the denominator.
